data.body:
Clarification from user: When the Homebrew install command is run directly, it works correctly:

  /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

The failure is specific to how create-dso-app.sh invokes the installer — the script passes the environment (including SNOWINTERACTIVE) to the subprocess, which forces the Homebrew installer into non-interactive mode where it then fails on sudo. The fix should suppress SNOWINTERACTIVE (and similar env vars) when invoking the Homebrew installer, or pre-flight detect and skip auto-install entirely.
